feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: Worries swirl that Russia is planning to test NATO with direct attacks
entry.summary: NPR's Elissa Nadworny speaks with Kurt Volker, former U.S. ambassador to NATO, about worries that Russia's "hybrid attacks" could lead to a direct military confrontation with NATO.

entry.title: Persecuted Chinese religious leader finds refuge in the U.S.
entry.summary: China is cracking down on underground churches, with one church leader finding refuge in the U.S.

entry.title: Could Germany's far-right AfD party gain ground in liberal Berlin?
entry.summary: The far-right AfD is campaigning in neighborhoods it previously would never have gone near, marking a noteworthy shift in the left-leaning capital city, where local elections take place on Sunday.

entry.title: The high stakes drama a reporter has seen covering the UN General Assembly
entry.summary: Over the years NPR's Michele Kelemen has seen high stakes diplomacy play out at the UN General Assembly.

entry.title: DEI and colleges
entry.summary: The President of Sacramento State talks about their Black honors college -- and how schools are dealing with DEI under the Trump administration. This story was produced with support from the Education Writers Association's Reporting Fellowship program.

entry.title: Taiwan's lost films hold the sounds and stories of a vanishing era
entry.summary: Researchers in Taiwan are racing to restore a crucial piece of the island's film history, before it's lost forever.

entry.title: Adéla's music is blunt and honest… She says that comes from her Slovak heritage
entry.summary: NPR's Elissa Nadworny speaks with Adéla, about the rising popstar's debut album, Prima.

entry.title: Carly Rae Jepsen's new album from warm and breezy day to thumping dance floor night
entry.summary: Carly Rae Jepsen has now been releasing critically-acclaimed pop music for more than a decade. And Friday, she's out with her eighth album, called Day and Night.

entry.title: Ole Miss and LSU face off in a rivalry made more bitter by Lane Kiffin's return
entry.summary: Lane Kiffin brings his LSU Tigers to the University of Mississippi for a highly-anticipated football game. Kiffin led Ole Miss for the past few seasons but bolted for LSU, angering many.

entry.title: 'Joyful protestors' talk about the cultural value of the Kennedy Center
entry.summary: The center, a beacon of American arts and culture, is slated to be closed after a board vote. On Friday, a group called Hands Off the Arts is holding what they call a "joyful protest" outside.
